name: Hacchake Ayayo-san 3 - Watashi, Icchattan Desu - Ayayo's Life After
original_name: はっちゃけあやよさん３ 私、逝っちゃったんです ＡＹＡＹＯ＇Ｓ ＬＩＦＥ ＡＦＴＥＲ
source:
This time, Ayayo and her friend Tomoko are taking a stroll and encounter a mysterious creature. Eventually they realize that they are both dead. From that point on the plot focuses on their sexual experiences with demons and Buddhist deities in heaven and hell.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/hacchake-ayayo-san-3-watashi-icchatta-n-desu]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
这一次，绫代与好友智子外出散步，途中遇见了一个神秘生物。最终，两人意识到自己其实都已经死了。从此，故事围绕她们在天堂与地狱里同恶魔及佛教神祇发生的性经历展开。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/hacchake-ayayo-san-3-watashi-icchatta-n-desu]Moby Games[/url]]
